input.quote: (a) At any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding, either party may terminate this Agreement for any or no reason upon fifteen (15) days advance notice to the other.
input.rationale: The convenience right is only available when no Statement of Work is outstanding, so in practice Company has no right to exit an open engagement without cause under an indefinite-term agreement — short of the fallback (Customer termination on 60–90 days' notice). Contractor also holds a 15-day convenience right, below the 90-day floor. Redline adds a 30-day Company convenience right with a pro-rata refund and moves Contractor to 90 days.

input.quote: 2. TERM. The term of this Agreement shall begin on the date hereof and shall continue until terminated by either party pursuant to Paragraph 6 hereof.
input.rationale: There is no automatic renewal mechanic, renewal term or non-renewal notice window: the Agreement simply runs until terminated under Paragraph 6, so there is no auto-renewal trap or renewal price uplift to cap. Nothing to redline under this rule (rate changes on 30 days' notice under 3(b) are a separate pricing point).
